banter-0-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Sophie, you raced here. What is the hardest part of this lap?

banter-1-1: chatterbox:e290442b|sophie|normal|And you can feel it. The old banking is still out there in the trees. Gives me chills every time.
banter-10-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Tyre temperatures are tricky at Monza, Sophie.
banter-10-1: chatterbox:e290442b|sophie|normal|The long straights cool them right down, and then you hit the biggest stop on the lap. It catches people out all the time.
banter-11-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Is it true the Coorva Grahndeh is flat out?

banter-12-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|If you could give one piece of advice for this circuit?

banter-13-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Look at the trees flashing by in the royal park.
banter-13-1: chatterbox:6d4fb15e|sophie|calm|It's a beautiful setting. Mind you, at this speed you don't get to enjoy the view much.
banter-14-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Monza rewards bravery, but it punishes mistakes.
banter-14-1: chatterbox:6d4fb15e|sophie|calm|And the walls are never far away. One moment of lost concentration, and it's over.
banter-15-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|What do the drivers eat before a race like this, Sophie?

banter-19-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|The crowd here really get behind everyone, don't they?

banter-20-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|What goes through a driver's mind on these long straights?

banter-22-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Is it scary, braking from these speeds?

banter-24-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|Who has impressed you most today?

banter-5-0: chatterbox:3bd1e2be|james|normal|The slipstream here is enormous, isn't it?
